title: I gave Qwen 3.8 27B a reverse-engineering job and it finished in 30 minutes
summary: The article discusses how Qwen 3.8 27B, a mid-sized open-source model, successfully completed a reverse-engineering task in 30 minutes, a job typically requiring human expertise. It highlights the model's capability in practical problem-solving, suggesting that smaller models can rival frontier models for specific tasks, with implications for cost-effective AI deployment.
